result.topic_en: Fragment 90, the last in the collection, gives two representations of the quartic form zz = aa + 2abx + max^2 + 2dex^3 + eex^4 with m = bb + dd - ff, and derives values of x that make it a square.
result.transcription:
266 L. EULERI OPERA POSTHUMA. Arithmetica.
90.
THEOREMA. Si proposita fuerit haec formula $zz = aa + 2abx + max^2 + 2dex^3 + eex^4$, in qua sit
$m = bb + dd - ff$,
tum eadem forma sequentibus modis repraesentari potest:
1) $zz = (a + bx)^2 + xx(ex + d + f)(ex + d - f)$
2) $zz = xx(ex + d)^2 + (a + (b + f)x)(a + (b - f)x)$,
unde sequitur $z = a + bx$ si fuerit vel $x = \frac{-d-f}{e}$, vel $x = \frac{-d+f}{e}$. Ex altera
$z = x(ex + d)$ si fuerit vel $x = \frac{-a}{b+f}$, vel $x = \frac{-a}{b-f}$.
Praeter hos quatuor valores operationes vulgares praebent adhuc sequentes sex valores
I. $x = \frac{2ae + ff - dd}{2e(a - b)}$, II. $x = \frac{2a(b - d)}{2ae + ff - bb}$, III. $x = \frac{2ae + ff - dd}{2e(d + b)}$, IV. $x = \frac{2a(b + d)}{-2ae + ff - bb}$,
V. $x = \frac{3aade + 4ab(ff - dd)}{(ff - dd)^2 - 4aaee}$, V. $x = \frac{(ff - bb)^2 - 4aaee}{8abee + 4de(ff - bb)}$.
A. m. T. III. p. 163.

methods.what: Representation of a quartic as square plus product of two linear factors times x^2, given m = b^2 + d^2 - f^2
methods.quote: $zz = (a + bx)^2 + xx(ex + d + f)(ex + d - f)$

methods.what: Second representation of the same quartic
Rational x making the quartic a square from vanishing of the linear factors
